title: Death of Jesus son of Nun
english: [[Jesus son of Nun’s death is read — one hundred ten years >> Bible:Judges 2:8]]. That Jesus died; our Jesus always lives. [[For me to live is Christ >> Bible:Philippians 1:21]]. Those who fall away [[crucify the Son of God again >> Bible:Hebrews 6:6]]. When Nun’s son is dead, the people decline.
